script.spoken: The river had burned at least fourteen times. In Cleveland, the Cuyahoga River caught fire. Suddenly flames spread across oily debris on the water. Factories had dumped waste into it for decades. Oil and debris floated on the surface. This fire drew national attention. It helped spark the modern environmental movement. It helped spur the Clean Water Act amendments and the EPA.
